value.rationale: The Tutte–Coxeter graph canonically realizes the exceptional outer automorphism of S6. The already known rank-nine homology hides a nontrivial irreducible module and polarity action, with four different outer-coset character signatures. This complete natural equivariant invariant is meaningful for studying duality symmetries of incidence complexes and cannot be deduced from Betti numbers or elementary graph automorphism counts. The exact module and entire duality class table supply value beyond a generic Lefschetz identity.
